ratings_why.fun: A push-your-luck turn in the shop with two opposite payoffs is a real decision every turn, and the Clean curve (Holt Kit, Spraint Keeper, Creeler, Old Wick) grows in a shape I'd want to climb with.
ratings_why.distinct: 8 because the bust is itself a growth tool: getting Caught Seizes, Tags and lets you rebuy a unit to replay its When played, so one Heat gauge drives two opposite builds, which no current tribe or generic auto-battler tribe does.

verdict_why: Two cards don't read cleanly yet (Pebble Jack's peek after a skip, Grisel's Tag count on stolen copies); fix those and it can settle.

points.text: Pebble Jack: say whether the roll you saw stays for the next Run after you skip, or is rolled again. The two readings play very differently.
Grisel: say whether her stolen copy gets one Tag or her own two, since her first line gives Seized units two Tags.

The Hot build's in-fight payoff caps at Limit+3 Heat, so its late game rests on Tags. A permanent hook, like Hothead gaining +1 Attack permanently each time you're Caught, would give it a growth curve too.
Tibby Slick's 2–3 rolls fight the Clean half from turn 1. If they applied only to his own Run, both builds would take him as the early tempo body.

standouts.why: Close-Shave Creeler's double at exactly the Limit is the tribe's skill test and a strong Tier 4 board buff.
Slipway Champion is great alone and becomes the Johnny loop when Seized and rebought.
Sergeant Squacco turns the bust into a plan: he takes the seizure, cools you, and comes back Tagged.

weakest.why: Tibby Slick is a small body whose drawback you sell him to escape.
Lantern Reach Hothead is a capped in-fight Attack bump that Officer Nyx outclasses.
Holt Kit's +1/+1 per two Clean Runs is a slow seed that shuts off the turn you bust.

flags.note: Old Wick at 5–6 clean Runs a turn with Squacco and Gran is about 3 bodies a turn, worth the owner's eye.
Seize-rebuy Slipway Champion under Grisel and Hackle grows +9/+9 plus two Tags a turn for 2 gold; it sits out while looping, so likely fine.
Thousand-Channel Pilot with Creel-Weaver and Moss can add three next-tier units a turn and pull the curve a tier early.
Whether the seen roll persists after a skip is not stated.
Tag count on Grisel's stolen copy is not stated.
